(2) findPlanForPhase's phase-plan matcher (`^.+-phase-${n}-.+\.plan\.md$`) is unanchored to a specific feature prefix, so under a narrow precondition (the current feature's own same-numbered plan absent from both PRPs/plans/ and PRPs/plans/completed/ while exactly one OTHER feature has an identically-numbered plan) it could in principle attribute a borrowed phase_scope value to the wrong feature; this exact glob shape was specified verbatim in the plan's own Task 1 ACTION text (not an implementer deviation), always degrades safely to omission rather than silent corruption in the far more common zero/multi-match cases (verified via my own ambiguous-multi-match dry run), and the practical precondition for misattribution is narrow. Recorded as a low-severity, forward-looking robustness observation, not a defect in what was asked for.
